description: Synthetic, credential-free SecWeaver cases for agent product evaluation.

cases.title: Confirm a successful WebShell attack
cases.title_zh: 确认 WebShell 攻击是否成功
cases.value: Correlates a WAF alert with host execution, network, and file evidence instead of stopping at a rule hit.
cases.value_zh: 把 WAF 告警与主机执行、网络和文件证据关联起来，而不是停留在规则命中。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case webshell-attack-confirmation and explain the evidence behind the verdict.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 webshell-attack-confirmation，并解释结论背后的证据。

cases.title: Recognize a false-positive request parameter
cases.title_zh: 识别请求参数误报
cases.value: Shows that SecWeaver can suppress a benign UUID-shaped parameter rather than escalating every WAF match.
cases.value_zh: 展示 SecWeaver 能识别 UUID 形态的正常参数，不会把每次 WAF 命中都升级为攻击。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case false-positive-parameter and explain why it should not be escalated.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 false-positive-parameter，并解释为什么不应该升级处置。

cases.title: Reconstruct WebShell-to-SSH lateral movement
cases.title_zh: 还原 WebShell 到 SSH 横向移动
cases.value: Correlates observed WebShell activity and confirmed multi-host SSH movement while marking the original compromise point and unmatched Web-to-host Join as unresolved.
cases.value_zh: 关联观察到的 WebShell 活动与多主机 SSH 横向证据，同时标出未证实的首次攻破点和未匹配的 Web 到主机 Join。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case webshell-to-ssh-lateral and show the entry point, execution, lateral path, evidence, and gaps.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 webshell-to-ssh-lateral，说明攻击入口、命令执行、横向路径、关键证据和数据缺口。

cases.title: Detect a reverse shell from host evidence
cases.title_zh: 从主机证据识别反弹 Shell
cases.value: Turns a host command event into a prioritized P0 risk with behavior tags and MITRE techniques.
cases.value_zh: 把主机命令事件转化为带行为标签和 MITRE 技术的 P0 高危风险。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case reverse-shell-risk and explain the behavior, severity, MITRE mapping, and response priority.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 reverse-shell-risk，并解释行为、严重级别、MITRE 映射和处置优先级。

cases.title: Stop traceability when host evidence is missing
cases.title_zh: 主机证据缺失时阻止过度结论
cases.value: Demonstrates evidence gating: SecWeaver identifies the missing host-execution source instead of claiming a clean result.
cases.value_zh: 展示证据门禁：缺少主机执行日志时明确报告缺口，而不是给出虚假的安全结论。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case missing-host-exec-data and explain which missing evidence blocks a trustworthy conclusion.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 missing-host-exec-data，并解释缺少哪些证据导致无法可信溯源。

cases.title: Complete traceability sources
cases.title_zh: 溯源数据源齐备
cases.value: Complete traceability sources
cases.value_zh: S1 外网 IP 溯源 — 数据源齐全
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s1-full-traceable.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s1-full-traceable。

cases.title: Alert triage without host evidence
cases.title_zh: 仅能告警分类
cases.value: Alert triage without host evidence
cases.value_zh: S4 仅 WEB/WAF — 可做告警分类，无法确认打穿
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s4-alert-triage-only.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s4-alert-triage-only。

cases.title: Missing connection evidence
cases.title_zh: 缺少主机连接证据
cases.value: Missing connection evidence
cases.value_zh: S4 P0 齐全、P1 host_connect 缺失
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s4-partial-missing-connect.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s4-partial-missing-connect。

cases.title: Generic scanner without payload
cases.title_zh: 无载荷的扫描器告警
cases.value: Generic scanner without payload
cases.value_zh: S4 扫描器/generic 规则无 payload
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s4-scanner-generic-no-payload.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s4-scanner-generic-no-payload。

cases.title: Blocked SQL injection attempt
cases.title_zh: SQL 注入被拦截
cases.value: Blocked SQL injection attempt
cases.value_zh: S4 SQLi 被 WAF 拦截，无主机侧证据
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s4-sqli-blocked-no-breach.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s4-sqli-blocked-no-breach。

cases.title: Scan without host execution
cases.title_zh: 仅扫描无主机执行
cases.value: Scan without host execution
cases.value_zh: S1 负例 — 仅扫描无打穿
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s1-scan-only-no-host-exec.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s1-scan-only-no-host-exec。

cases.title: Initial access without confirmed lateral movement
cases.title_zh: 主机执行但无确认横向
cases.value: Initial access without confirmed lateral movement
cases.value_zh: S2 打穿无横向 — initial_access_only
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s2-initial-access-no-lateral.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s2-initial-access-no-lateral。

cases.title: Download and execute from a Web process
cases.title_zh: Web 进程下载执行
cases.value: Download and execute from a Web process
cases.value_zh: S5 nginx 子进程 curl|bash 下载执行 + 外连
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-curl-download-exec-p0.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-curl-download-exec-p0。

cases.title: Outbound connection from a Web listener
cases.title_zh: Web 监听进程主动外连
cases.value: Outbound connection from a Web listener
cases.value_zh: S5 Web 监听进程主动外连（合成文档地址）
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-external-connect-p0.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-external-connect-p0。

cases.title: Whitelisted nginx configuration test
cases.title_zh: nginx 配置检查白名单
cases.value: Whitelisted nginx configuration test
cases.value_zh: S5 nginx -t 运维白名单
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-nginx-config-test-whitelisted.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-nginx-config-test-whitelisted。

cases.title: SSH authorized keys modification
cases.title_zh: SSH 授权密钥变更
cases.value: SSH authorized keys modification
cases.value_zh: S5 持久化变更：修改 SSH authorized_keys
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-persistence-authorized-keys-p0.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-persistence-authorized-keys-p0。

cases.title: Ten SSH authentication failures
cases.title_zh: SSH 十次失败达到阈值
cases.value: Ten SSH authentication failures
cases.value_zh: S5 SSH 同源十次认证失败
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-ssh-bruteforce-p0.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-ssh-bruteforce-p0。

cases.title: Nine SSH failures below threshold
cases.title_zh: SSH 九次失败未达阈值
cases.value: Nine SSH failures below threshold
cases.value_zh: S5 SSH 同源九次认证失败，未达到十次阈值
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-ssh-nine-failures-below-threshold.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-ssh-nine-failures-below-threshold。

cases.title: Discovery from a Web process shell
cases.title_zh: Web 进程 shell 侦察
cases.value: Discovery from a Web process shell
cases.value_zh: S5 nginx 子进程 whoami 侦察（shell 执行仍为 P0）
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s5-whoami-recon-p0.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s5-whoami-recon-p0。

cases.title: Suspicious DNS without connection evidence
cases.title_zh: 异常 DNS 且缺少外连证据
cases.value: Suspicious DNS without connection evidence
cases.value_zh: S8 异常 DNS 域名，缺少可关联外连事件
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s8-dns-dga-p1.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s8-dns-dga-p1。

cases.title: Complete account-compromise data sources
cases.title_zh: 账号失陷调查数据源齐备
cases.value: Authentication, post-login execution, persistence, and firewall sources are registered.
cases.value_zh: 认证、登录后执行、持久化和防火墙数据源均已注册。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s6-full-traceable and explain what the readiness result does not prove.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s6-full-traceable，并说明数据源齐备不能证明什么。

cases.title: Account investigation without authentication logs
cases.title_zh: 账号调查缺少认证日志
cases.value: Post-login sources cannot replace the P0 authentication source.
cases.value_zh: 登录后数据源不能替代 P0 认证日志。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s6-not-traceable-missing-auth and explain the blocking evidence gap.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s6-not-traceable-missing-auth，并解释阻断调查的证据缺口。

cases.title: Complete data-exfiltration sources
cases.title_zh: 数据外传调查数据源齐备
cases.value: File, connection, DNS, traffic-volume, and execution sources are registered.
cases.value_zh: 文件、外连、DNS、流量体量和执行数据源均已注册。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s7-full-traceable and explain the boundary between source readiness and proven exfiltration.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s7-full-traceable，并说明数据源齐备与外传已证实的区别。

cases.title: Exfiltration investigation without traffic volume
cases.title_zh: 外传调查缺少流量体量
cases.value: Required file and connection sources exist, but transfer volume cannot be established.
cases.value_zh: 文件与外连数据源可用，但不能确认传输体量。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s7-partial-missing-traffic-volume and explain the remaining conclusion limit.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s7-partial-missing-traffic-volume，并解释剩余的结论限制。

cases.title: Mixed alert batch with an incomplete query
cases.title_zh: 混合告警批次与查询缺口
cases.value: One batch separates a false positive, a scan, and a blocked attack while preserving a failed host query.
cases.value_zh: 同一批次区分误报、扫描与被拦截攻击，同时保留主机查询失败。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s4-batch-mixed-with-query-gap and explain both per-alert outcomes and the query limitation.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s4-batch-mixed-with-query-gap，并解释逐告警结果和查询限制。

cases.title: Suspicious root SSH login
cases.title_zh: 异常 root SSH 登录
cases.value: A successful external root login is a review candidate, not proof that the account is compromised.
cases.value_zh: 外部 root 登录成功需要复核，但不能单独证明账号已失陷。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s6-root-ssh-login-p1 and explain why the event is suspicious without claiming account compromise.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s6-root-ssh-login-p1，并说明为什么事件可疑但不能断言账号失陷。

cases.title: Data staging and outbound SCP candidate
cases.title_zh: 数据暂存与 SCP 外发候选
cases.value: Same-process staging, SCP, and connection evidence raises priority without proving transfer completion.
cases.value_zh: 同进程暂存、SCP 与外连证据提升处置优先级，但不能证明传输完成。
cases.prompt: Run the SecWeaver offline case s7-data-staging-and-scp-p0 and separate observed behavior from unproven transfer success.
cases.prompt_zh: 运行 SecWeaver 离线案例 s7-data-staging-and-scp-p0，并区分已观察行为与尚未证实的传输成功。
